cases.expectation: Import old receipt with resume_ready true, preserve exact raw bytes including whitespace and retain flag only as receipt_resume_ready; entry historical resume_ready false and store freshness false.
cases.name: historical stale ready receipt

cases.expectation: Refuse wrong expected receipt SHA with zero history mutation.
cases.name: wrong receipt digest

cases.expectation: Refuse incorrect expected tip with zero history mutation.
cases.name: stale tip

cases.expectation: Refuse receipt/import identity mismatch with zero history mutation.
cases.name: wrong journey identity

cases.expectation: Refuse blank and >4096 Unicode reasons without mutation.
cases.name: blank and oversized reasons

cases.expectation: Reader rejects v2 entry with forged current origin even when entry filename digest recomputed.
cases.name: forged version 2 origin

cases.expectation: Reader rejects extra/missing keys, invalid base64, malformed chain without accepting partial prefix as valid store.
cases.name: malformed v2 and base64

cases.expectation: v1 append then v2 import then current v1 append keeps old bytes unchanged, links chain, v1 exact six keys, extracts both exact original raw receipts.
cases.name: mixed chain exact extract

cases.expectation: Import refuses active lock or abandoned stage, no cleanup/mutation.
cases.name: locks and stages

cases.expectation: Inject removal failure after one selected unlink in ordinary maintenance, generate fresh recovery plan with remaining/complement, finish, restore backup ZIP via existing versions tooling; HEAD and previous bytes unchanged.
cases.name: interrupted maintenance

cases.expectation: Corrupted copied ZIP or altered manifest refused before new unlink.
cases.name: tampered archive bytes

cases.expectation: Missing selected ZIP or incomplete/staging archive refused without reconstruction or cleanup.
cases.name: incomplete archive

cases.expectation: Selected revision now HEAD or previous is refused, preserving protected bytes.
cases.name: current protected revision

cases.expectation: Current store changed after plan; apply refuses before new unlink.
cases.name: stale recovery plan

cases.expectation: Refuse wrong expected hash and missing approval before unlink.
cases.name: wrong expected plan hash

cases.expectation: Unknown file in either tree refuses without removal or cleanup.
cases.name: unknown archive or store file

cases.expectation: Valid ZIP from different journey refused before unlink.
cases.name: foreign archive identity

cases.expectation: Inject failure after one new recovery unlink; old plan now stale; fresh plan can finish, complete archive unchanged.
cases.name: repeated partial recovery fault

cases.expectation: Already completed original selection produces empty remaining and full already_absent, apply verified no-op; modified archive still refused.
cases.name: empty verified noop

cases.expectation: Archive within store, store within archive, store lock and archive-parent maintenance lock refuse with no cleanup.
cases.name: archive/store ancestry and locks

cases.expectation: Respond to supplied old ready receipt; optional import with exact explicit reason/digest/tip and state history is not current resume approval.
cases.name: historical import without freshness promotion

cases.expectation: For interrupted removal use validated complete archive and fresh explicit plan/apply; incomplete archive or abandoned locks require inspection/manual reconciliation, never recreate/delete/replay.
cases.name: complete backup recovery vs incomplete and locks

cases.expectation: Ordinary edit request with incidental learning vocabulary must not create journey/store or activate teaching workflow.
cases.name: ordinary work nonactivation

cases.expectation: Unknown time/resources or learner self-report does not become verified mastery/readiness; safety concerns constrain activity without diagnosis/truth claims.
cases.name: unknown resources self-report safety

constraints: Never inspect candidate before parent readiness
Never relax checks after implementation inspection
evaluator: independent delegated context; inherited model/effort unknown; no new agents/API/services
fault_groups_frozen_before_implementatio: partial unlink after first success, repeated fault, empty verified noop
fault_injection_policy: Resolve actual unlink/link injection points only after parent readiness; throw after one completed selected unlink and before next selected unlink, preserving actual filesystem partial state. No code-under-test weakening.
model_method: Four literal scenario prompts, baseline and candidate skill instructions separately; same evaluator both arms, nonblind self-generation/grading, fresh delegated context relative to implementation author, model/settings unknown. Report capability evidence only.
